mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue growth prospects deteriorate, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST and INDPRO both decline from prior month, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer spending, which typically leads to lower corporate revenues and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 115.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 115.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in housing starts indicate a dual stress in the labor and housing markets, which typically triggers a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days as economic uncertainty rises.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and HOUST declines from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE rises and HOUST declines from prior month, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the easing cycle supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
